title: AllowanceResponse
description: How much the caller may still spend on one source this calendar month (UTC), from the store's monthlyUsd setting and the spend recorded in the caller's partition.

month.description: The calendar month in UTC, as YYYY-MM.

capUsd.description: The monthly cap in US dollars for this source, or null when monthlyUsd gives none.

spentUsd.description: US dollars the caller's partition recorded for this source this month.

remainingUsd.description: capUsd less spentUsd, below zero when the cap was overspent; null when there is no cap.
